data.one_liner: A flutter plugin to view and encode avif images using libavif.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to view, decode, cache, and encode AVIF images across multiple platforms. It provides custom widgets like AvifImage and CachedNetworkAvifImage as well as support for animated AVIFs.
use_when: Your app needs to render AVIF image formats from assets, files, or network sources.
You need to encode or decode AVIF images directly within a Flutter application.
You need support for animated AVIF playback with custom animation controllers.
avoid_when: You only need standard image formats like JPEG or PNG and want to minimize native binary dependencies.
You do not need AVIF-specific features.
strengths: Comprehensive cross-platform support including mobile, desktop, and web.
Supports encoding, decoding, and custom animation control for multiframe AVIFs.
weaknesses: Relies on native binaries via libavif which adds platform complexity.
Not documented for server-side or non-Flutter Dart usage.
data.setup_notes: Follow the installation instructions on pub.dev to add the package to your Flutter application.
